grades.name: SQL injection in admin user search (re-check)
grades.evidence: app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb:8 changed from `@users.where("email ILIKE '%#{params[:search]}%'")` (string-interpolated, injectable) to `@users.where("email ILIKE ?", "%#{params[:search]}%")` — a proper bound-parameter placeholder; the params value is now a bind, not part of the SQL string. `git diff 0b87cde..6341f29 -- app/controllers/admin/users_controller.rb` shows exactly this one-line hardening (index 85ae1bb..da3c42c). Exploit `?search=x' OR '1'='1 --` no longer breaks out of the literal. FIXED on the model's own initiative during sprint 5 (pre-reveal) => full Critical-5 weight.
